title: Which Phone, Grandma?
subtitle: Jo is buying Black Friday earbuds for Grandma June. One question changes the order.
end: Which earbuds fit your phone? Twelve pairs, compared below.

art.prompt: Thanksgiving evening in a warm, cozy kitchen after dinner, string lights and a half-eaten pie on the counter. Jo sits at the wooden kitchen table with an open laptop, seen from the side so its blank screen glow lights her face; the back of the lid is matte plain gray with no emblem, no light and no shape on it. She looks excited, leaning in. Grandma June sits in an armchair nearby knitting, smiling fondly at her. Medium-wide shot from slightly above, with a tall warm wall and ceiling filling the upper third of the same scene. Full-bleed single image, edge to edge, no split frames, no bands.

items.text: Thanksgiving night. The Black Friday deals are already up.
Grandma, I'm getting you earbuds. The fancy white ones are on sale!

items.text: Earbuds are built around one kind of phone. The sale ad rarely says which.

items.text: Lovely, dear. Will they work with my phone?
It's the one your cousin set up. Not an iPhone.

items.text: Fit is what happy owners mention first. Run the fit test in the app, too.
And keep the receipt. One bud that stops charging is the classic complaint.
